messages.subject: v1.3.6 released
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

I am releasing STITCH 1.3.6, which fixes some small bugs, and updates using a reference panel for imputation by allowing for imputation from a reference panel with no EM updates provided the reference panel and sites to impute are the same

https://github.com/rwdavies/STITCH

Best,

Robbie
